data.gender_notes: Naushad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of a great advisor and a leader in Islamic history, Naushad. It is derived from the Arabic word 'naushad' which means 'gifted advisor'. This name signifies a person who is wise, knowledgeable, and can provide valuable guidance to others. The name Naushad carries the meaning “Gifted advisor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Naushad usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted advisor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Naushad is a name that carries a deep spiritual meaning. It signifies a person who is connected to the divine and has the ability to provide guidance and wisdom to others. This name is often given to children who are believed to have a special gift for helping others and resolving conflicts.
data.etymology: Naushad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted advisor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naushad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: نوشاد

data.cultural_impact: The name Naushad holds significant cultural importance in the Muslim community due to its association with one of the greatest Muslim advisors and warriors, Malik Naushad. He was a Turkish general of the Mughal emperor Akbar, known for his military strategies and bravery. Malik Naushad's name has been passed down through generations, inspiring many to strive for greatness and leadership, and a desire to be a trusted advisor to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Naushad represents the spiritual gift of wisdom and guidance. It is a reminder to seek knowledge and understanding, both from the world and from the divine. As a spiritual name, it calls us to be a blessing to others, by sharing our wisdom and offering guidance to those who seek it. Thus, the name Naushad carries a profound spiritual significance, encouraging us to cultivate knowledge, wisdom, and to share it generously with others.
